title: SaaS 产品
description: 获客、激活试用、实际支付及订阅收入业务域；通过成熟队列漏斗与有效期订阅快照诊断。 报告年度2025，观察延伸至2026-03-31；仅合成数据，结论必须从实际查询计算。

tables.name: accounts
tables.description: 1000个账户，包括获客渠道、行业和企业规模；2025Q4注册与前期不同

tables.name: users
tables.description: 5000名账户成员；账户级指标不得混用用户或事件数

tables.name: events
tables.description: 真实业务活跃事件report_created/workflow_run/data_viewed；注册、后台心跳不是活跃

tables.name: subscriptions
tables.description: 订阅有效区间为[start_date,end_date)，monthly_price已归一到月，不是原始年费

tables.name: subscription_changes
tables.description: 订阅变更事件，取消不是新增负收入账单

tables.name: invoices
tables.description: 账单收款记录，paid计入现金收款，open不计；年费账单不可直接当MRR

tables.name: business_calendar
tables.description: 日期维度，月末快照以calendar_date为观测点

tables.name: account_attribution
tables.description: 单一主来源归属，非多触点因果归因

tables.name: feature_events
tables.description: 账户首次价值事件及触发用户

tables.name: account_usage
tables.description: 产品使用与错误事件聚合，不等于客户流失原因

tables.name: payment_attempts
tables.description: 同一账单可多次支付尝试，success才是成功支付

tables.name: subscription_versions
tables.description: 订阅价格有效期版本；左闭右开，可有取消后的恢复区间

relations.description: 月末日期落在订阅版本有效区间，不能用任意非等值JOIN代替此批准关系。
relations.preaggregation: 每个订阅在任意时点最多一个有效版本；先按时点账户汇总MRR，禁止与事件事实明细直接关联。
两侧先在所需完整粒度聚合，再使用全部批准键关联
relations.description: 两侧先在所需完整粒度聚合，再使用全部批准键关联

metrics.name: 月活跃用户
metrics.description: 自然月发生至少一次report_created/workflow_run/data_viewed的去重用户；不把注册或心跳算活跃。

metrics.name: 新增账户
metrics.description: 按账户signup_date计数，用户数不能代替账户数。

metrics.name: 30日订阅开通转化率
metrics.description: 注册后30日内有订阅开始的去重账户数/成熟注册账户数，这是订阅开通率，不是付款成功率。仅在用户明确询问订阅开通时使用；一般付费转化和环节流失使用paid_funnel_rate，不应因为包含‘转化’二字同时要求两种口径。只纳入signup_date+30天<=含当日的观察截止日期的成熟队列，未成熟不计为未转化。
filters: 注册账户已完整观察30天
metrics.denominator: 已完整观察30天的注册账户数

metrics.name: 月度经常性收入
metrics.description: 指定月末仍生效的订阅版本月价，effective_from<=时点且(effective_to为空或>时点)。已月度归一，不再次除12；需使用版本表处理升降级与恢复，而不是订阅主表当前字段。

metrics.name: 7日用户留存率
metrics.description: 按用户注册队列统计注册后第7天至第13天至少一次有效事件的去重用户比例；仅纳入已完整观察13天的用户，分子分母均为用户粒度。
filters: 注册用户已完整观察13天
metrics.denominator: 已完整观察13天的注册用户数

metrics.name: 账单收款
metrics.description: 按invoice_date统计status='paid'账单金额，指标是现金收款不是MRR或权责收入。

metrics.name: 付费账户流失率
metrics.description: 以期初有效付费账户为分母，其中在本期结束前失去所有有效订阅的账户为分子；不得直接使用取消事件数除新增账户数。
metrics.denominator: 期初拥有有效订阅的账户数

metrics.name: 30日实际付费转化率（顺序漏斗）
metrics.description: 本模板未额外指定的付费转化及环节流失采用此实际成功支付口径：同一成熟注册账户队列在signup_date至signup_date+30天（两端包含）内按首次价值→试用→支付成功的顺序到达，各阶段按account_id去重，支付重试不重复计人；成熟条件signup_date+30天<=含当日的观察截止日。订阅开通不等于付费成功，不应另用conversion_30d替代。联合分组group为获客渠道×企业规模时，结构/组内转化分摊也是该联合分组的贡献，不能描述成纯渠道结构贡献；单独渠道或规模汇总表用于该维度转化与步骤流失比较。
filters: 注册账户已完整观察30天

metrics.name: 期初账户群净收入留存率
metrics.description: 固定期初有正MRR的账户集合，其报告期MRR/期初MRR；允许扩张超过100%，不混入报告期新账户。
metrics.denominator: 固定期初账户群的期初MRR

metrics.name: 注册队列周龄留存率
metrics.description: 按注册月份划分用户队列。周龄w的留存分子为注册后[7*w,7*w+6]天至少发生一次业务事件（report_created、workflow_run、data_viewed）的去重用户；多周比较统一使用已完整观察到最大周龄的成熟队列，保留样本量。第1/4/8周分别对应7-13/28-34/56-62天。
filters: 注册用户已完整观察最大周龄
metrics.denominator: 相同最大观察窗口下的成熟注册用户数

metrics.name: 支付失败影响账单数
metrics.description: 按失败原因统计至少一次失败尝试的去重账单；同一账单可属于多个原因，不可跨原因直接合计去重账单数。失败后可能重试成功，不等于最终坏账。

metrics.name: 账户30/60/90日留存
metrics.description: 注册日为day0，账户第24至30/54至60/84至90天（两端均包含）出现report_created、workflow_run或data_viewed至少一次为D30/D60/D90留存。按account_id去重；观察截止日含当日完整记录，成熟资格分别是signup_date+30/60/90天<=observation_end。这里D90窗口包含day90，与电商90日价值的[day0,day90)不是同一窗口。关键功能分组仅用前7日[day0,day7)的automation_saved，不能使用未来行为；样本<30标低样本，不作因果结论。
metrics.grain: 注册月份×前7日关键功能使用分组×观察窗口
filters: 遵循指标描述中的期间、状态和成熟窗口
metrics.denominator: 相同队列中已经完整观察到该窗口结束的账户数

business_knowledge.title: 收款不等于MRR
business_knowledge.content: MRR是月末有效订阅的归一化月价格，现金收款受年付账单影响。subscriptions.monthly_price已归一为月价，年付订阅不能再次除12，也不能直接累计账单求MRR。

business_knowledge.title: 留存和转化需要完整观察期
business_knowledge.content: 注册队列未达到完整观察期时应排除或标记未成熟，不将其视为零转化或零留存。使用场景数据截止日，而非假装有实时数据。

business_knowledge.title: 账户与用户是不同粒度
business_knowledge.content: 一个组织账户可有多个用户。付费转化和账户流失按account_id去重；活跃与用户留存按user_id去重。事件数不能代替用户数。

business_knowledge.title: 订阅有效区间边界
business_knowledge.content: 订阅从start_date起生效，在end_date当天不再有效。月末MRR使用左闭右开区间，取消事件统计与期初客户流失率必须区分。

business_knowledge.title: 历史MRR需使用版本有效期
business_knowledge.content: 升降级或恢复后，订阅主表无法代表所有历史月价。历史MRR按subscription_versions左闭右开区间取值；期初/期末账户净变动与全期间事件毛额不同。

business_knowledge.title: 开通与收款转化分开
business_knowledge.content: 订阅开通与真实成功支付是两种不同的转化定义。顺序漏斗只能使用同一成熟账户队列，并按账户去重支付重试；未成熟队列不算未转化。

preferences.title: 留存默认按注册周
preferences.description: 留存问题未指定队列时按注册周；明确注册月要求优先。

preferences.title: 展示样本量
preferences.description: 转化和留存结果同时查询并展示分母人数或账户数。

preferences.title: 优先关注付费转化
preferences.description: 产品概览可优先规划30日付费转化，不改变MRR等明确问题的目标。

repair_experiences.title: 日期函数方言不兼容
repair_experiences.content: DuckDB日期截断使用date_trunc，遇到其他数据库的月份截断函数应替换为当前方言等价写法；保持月初到下一月初的时间边界。
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(event_date,'%Y-%m'),COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY 1
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT strftime(event_date,'%Y-%m'),COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

repair_experiences.title: 把月价列写成账单金额列
repair_experiences.content: 生成订阅收入查询时需核对Schema，订阅表的月价字段是monthly_price，不是账单表的amount。修复字段引用后仍按有效区间验证口径。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE subscriptions(subscription_id INTEGER,monthly_price DOUBLE,start_date DATE,end_date DATE)
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_price) FROM subscriptions WHERE start_date<=DATE '2025-01-31' AND(end_date IS NULL OR end_date>DATE '2025-01-31')

repair_experiences.title: 年费收款被当成MRR
repair_experiences.content: 年付账单金额不能直接作为月经常性收入。回到已按月归一的订阅价格，在指定月末筛选有效订阅后求和；不要对monthly_price再除12。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE subscriptions(subscription_id INTEGER,monthly_price DOUBLE,start_date DATE,end_date DATE)
CREATE TABLE invoices(subscription_id INTEGER,amount DOUBLE,status VARCHAR)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM invoices WHERE status='paid'
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT SUM(monthly_price) FROM subscriptions WHERE start_date<=DATE '2025-01-31' AND(end_date IS NULL OR end_date>DATE '2025-01-31')

repair_experiences.title: 活跃事件数被当成活跃用户数
repair_experiences.content: 同一用户一天或一个月可以产生多次活跃事件。月活指标应按user_id去重计数，不能用事件行数作为用户数。
fixture_sql: CREATE TABLE events(event_id INTEGER,user_id INTEGER,event_date DATE)
repair_experiences.broken_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND event_date<DATE '2025-02-01'
repair_experiences.fixed_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM events WHERE event_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND event_date<DATE '2025-02-01'

clarifications.question: 看看留存怎么样。
clarifications.answer: 按2025年6月注册用户，分析注册后第7至13天的用户留存，并展示样本量。

clarifications.question: 今年收入多少？
clarifications.answer: 分析2025年每月末MRR，而不是当月收款。

diagnostics.title: 成熟注册账户30日顺序漏斗
diagnostics.description: 比较两个注册队列期间（如Q4与Q3）的注册、价值激活、试用及30日真实成功付费漏斗；按获客渠道和企业规模分解转化与步骤流失。非同期发生事件的简单计数，须保证注册队列完整观察30天。

queries.sql:
WITH f AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(event_date) first_value FROM feature_events WHERE event_type='first_value' GROUP BY account_id),t AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(start_date) trial_started FROM trials GROUP BY account_id),p AS(SELECT i.account_id,MIN(a.attempt_date) paid_date FROM invoices i JOIN payment_attempts a ON i.invoice_id=a.invoice_id WHERE a.outcome='success' GROUP BY i.account_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN a.signup_date<DATE '2025-10-01' THEN '2025-Q3' ELSE '2025-Q4' END period,a.acquisition_channel||' / '||a.company_size AS "group",a.acquisition_channel channel,a.company_size,
COUNT(*) registered,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND f.first_value<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') activated,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND t.trial_started<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') trial_started,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND p.paid_date>=t.trial_started AND p.paid_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') paid
FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN f ON a.account_id=f.account_id LEFT JOIN t ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN p ON a.account_id=p.account_id
WHERE a.signup_date>=DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.signup_date<DATE '2026-01-01' AND a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2

diagnostics.title: 连续月份MRR净变动与客户贡献
diagnostics.description: 连续月份账户MRR净变动：保留报告范围内全部月末和前一月末期初快照，逐月区分新增、扩张、收缩、流失、恢复，年度五项桥接并定位客户贡献。不能只保留起止两个月；账单收款不是MRR。

queries.sql:
WITH history AS(SELECT a.account_id,MIN(s.start_date) first_started FROM accounts a JOIN subscriptions s ON a.account_id=s.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id)
SELECT strftime(c.calendar_date,'%Y-%m-%d') period,v.account_id,SUM(v.monthly_price) mrr,MIN(h.first_started) first_started
FROM business_calendar c JOIN subscription_versions v ON c.calendar_date>=v.effective_from AND(c.calendar_date<v.effective_to OR v.effective_to IS NULL) JOIN history h ON v.account_id=h.account_id
WHERE c.is_month_end AND c.calendar_date>=DATE '2024-12-31' AND c.calendar_date<=DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id ORDER BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id

diagnostics.title: 成熟账户30/60/90日留存与早期关键功能分组
diagnostics.description: 账户注册月份队列D30/60/90留存：按注册后24–30、54–60、84–90日业务活跃去重，按前7日automation_saved暴露分组。完整展示各注册月份与观察窗口，并披露成熟样本和低样本；不得按未来功能使用分组。

queries.sql:
WITH activity AS(SELECT u.account_id,e.event_date FROM users u JOIN events e ON u.user_id=e.user_id WHERE e.event_name IN('report_created','workflow_run','data_viewed')),
active AS(SELECT a.account_id,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '24 days' AND e.event_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r30,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '54 days' AND e.event_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '60 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r60,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '84 days' AND e.event_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r90 FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN activity e ON a.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id),
k AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(event_date) first_key FROM feature_events WHERE event_type='key_feature' AND feature_name='automation_saved' GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT strftime(a.signup_date,'%Y-%m') cohort,CASE WHEN k.first_key>=a.signup_date AND k.first_key<a.signup_date+INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'early_key_feature' ELSE 'no_early_key_feature' END feature_group,COUNT(*) accounts,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31') eligible_30,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' AND v.r30=1) retained_30,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '60 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31') eligible_60,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '60 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' AND v.r60=1) retained_60,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '90 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31') eligible_90,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '90 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' AND v.r90=1) retained_90
FROM accounts a JOIN active v ON a.account_id=v.account_id LEFT JOIN k ON a.account_id=k.account_id WHERE a.signup_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.signup_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

cards.title: 成熟注册账户30日顺序漏斗

query.sql:
WITH f AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(event_date) first_value FROM feature_events WHERE event_type='first_value' GROUP BY account_id),t AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(start_date) trial_started FROM trials GROUP BY account_id),p AS(SELECT i.account_id,MIN(a.attempt_date) paid_date FROM invoices i JOIN payment_attempts a ON i.invoice_id=a.invoice_id WHERE a.outcome='success' GROUP BY i.account_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN a.signup_date<DATE '2025-10-01' THEN '2025-Q3' ELSE '2025-Q4' END period,a.acquisition_channel||' / '||a.company_size AS "group",a.acquisition_channel channel,a.company_size,
COUNT(*) registered,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND f.first_value<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') activated,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND t.trial_started<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') trial_started,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE f.first_value>=a.signup_date AND t.trial_started>=f.first_value AND p.paid_date>=t.trial_started AND p.paid_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days') paid
FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN f ON a.account_id=f.account_id LEFT JOIN t ON a.account_id=t.account_id LEFT JOIN p ON a.account_id=p.account_id
WHERE a.signup_date>=DATE '2025-07-01' AND a.signup_date<DATE '2026-01-01' AND a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1,2

cards.title: 连续月份MRR净变动与客户贡献

query.sql:
WITH history AS(SELECT a.account_id,MIN(s.start_date) first_started FROM accounts a JOIN subscriptions s ON a.account_id=s.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id)
SELECT strftime(c.calendar_date,'%Y-%m-%d') period,v.account_id,SUM(v.monthly_price) mrr,MIN(h.first_started) first_started
FROM business_calendar c JOIN subscription_versions v ON c.calendar_date>=v.effective_from AND(c.calendar_date<v.effective_to OR v.effective_to IS NULL) JOIN history h ON v.account_id=h.account_id
WHERE c.is_month_end AND c.calendar_date>=DATE '2024-12-31' AND c.calendar_date<=DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id ORDER BY c.calendar_date,v.account_id

cards.title: 成熟账户30/60/90日留存与早期关键功能分组

query.sql:
WITH activity AS(SELECT u.account_id,e.event_date FROM users u JOIN events e ON u.user_id=e.user_id WHERE e.event_name IN('report_created','workflow_run','data_viewed')),
active AS(SELECT a.account_id,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '24 days' AND e.event_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r30,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '54 days' AND e.event_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '60 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r60,MAX(CASE WHEN e.event_date>=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '84 days' AND e.event_date<=a.signup_date+INTERVAL '90 days' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r90 FROM accounts a LEFT JOIN activity e ON a.account_id=e.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id),
k AS(SELECT account_id,MIN(event_date) first_key FROM feature_events WHERE event_type='key_feature' AND feature_name='automation_saved' GROUP BY account_id)
SELECT strftime(a.signup_date,'%Y-%m') cohort,CASE WHEN k.first_key>=a.signup_date AND k.first_key<a.signup_date+INTERVAL '7 days' THEN 'early_key_feature' ELSE 'no_early_key_feature' END feature_group,COUNT(*) accounts,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31') eligible_30,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '30 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' AND v.r30=1) retained_30,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '60 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31') eligible_60,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '60 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' AND v.r60=1) retained_60,
COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '90 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31') eligible_90,COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE a.signup_date+INTERVAL '90 days'<=DATE '2026-03-31' AND v.r90=1) retained_90
FROM accounts a JOIN active v ON a.account_id=v.account_id LEFT JOIN k ON a.account_id=k.account_id WHERE a.signup_date>=DATE '2025-01-01' AND a.signup_date<DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
